name: Henge experimental (Tomba247, unofficial)
subtitle: Unofficial test builds. Henge is by Leviidev.
description: Unofficial test builds from github.com/Tomba247/Henge, a fork of Henge. Henge (github.com/Leviidev/Henge, GPL-2.0-or-later) is made by Leviidev and its contributors: all credit for Henge goes to them, and the official app is theirs. This fork only adds experimental features on top, such as the Linux machine (Ubuntu and Kali desktops on Henge's engine), and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by the Henge project. Henge needs JIT (StikJIT or StikDebug) and the increased-memory and extended-addressing entitlements, so sign it with a development certificate.

apps.name: Henge
apps.subtitle: macOS on your iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Henge runs macOS on iPhone and iPad: a virtual machine with its own arm64 translator, emulated devices and Metal graphics. Henge is made by Leviidev and its contributors (github.com/Leviidev/Henge); all credit for it goes to them.

These are unofficial test builds from a fork (github.com/Tomba247/Henge) that adds a Linux machine: Ubuntu and Kali desktops on Henge's engine, with the phone's GPU for 3D. They're not official Henge releases and aren't affiliated with or endorsed by the Henge project. Get the official app from Leviidev, and report problems with these builds to Tomba247, not to Henge.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Henge uses the local network to pair with this iPhone for JIT, without a computer.
